001: Hello, I would like to open an account here.
Of course, do you have an ID?
Yes, here is my passport and proof of address.
Perfect, I will prepare the file.
Are there any fees for the bank card?
No, the card is free for the first year.
002: I need to transfer money to a friend.
You can do it directly on the app.
Yes, you just need to enter their account number.
And does the money arrive right away?
003: I think I went over my authorized overdraft.
Oh no, we need to check your balance.
I don't understand, I was careful though.
There might be an automatic withdrawal.
Can you show me the transaction details?
Of course, I'll print the statement for you right away.
004: I would like to report my card stolen.
Did you lose it or was it stolen from you?
I think it was stolen from me on the subway.
Don't worry, I'm blocking it immediately.
And for the new card, how long does it take?
You will receive it within five business days.
005: I would like to open a savings account.
That's a good idea for putting money aside.
What is the interest rate right now?
It is three percent per year.
Very well, I'll take care of the opening.
006: I received a message about a suspicious payment.
It might be a fraud attempt.
Don't click on any links and call us.
I'll call you right away then.
That's the right reaction, we'll check together.
007: I would like to increase my card limit.
What amount would you like to set it to?
To two thousand euros per week.
That's possible, but you will need to provide justification.
In that case, I'll make the change right away.
008: I can't log in to my customer account.
Did you try resetting your password?
Yes, but I'm not receiving the code by text message.
Check that your number is up to date.
Oh, I changed my number last month.
That's the problem, I'll update it in the system.
009: I would like to close my account here.
May I ask you the reason for this decision?
I understand, that's a good reason.
Are there any fees for closing it?
No, it's free, but the balance needs to be zero.
010: You can order one on the app.
I prefer to do it here directly.
No problem, I'll order one for you.
When can I come pick it up?
It will be available in three days.
